arxiv-1707-00830.description: Abstract . The present paper deals with the study of generalized ϕ \phi -recurrent generalized ( k , μ ) (k,\mu) -contact metric manifolds with the existence of such notion by a proper example. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C15, 53C25. 1.

arxiv-1907-06364.title: Validating Planck SZ2 Clusters with Optical Counterparts
arxiv-1907-06364.creator: P. Banerjee, E. Pierpaoli, N. Mirzatuny, K. Maamari, P. Rim
arxiv-1907-06364.description: Abstract We perform an extensive analysis of optical counterparts of Planck PSZ2 clusters, considering matches with three recent catalogs built from Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) data: AMF DR9, redMaPPer (v6.3) and Wen et al (WHL). We significantly extend the number of optical counterparts of detected Planck clusters, and characterize the optical properties when multiple identifications in different catalogs exist.

arxiv-2204-03609.title: Pin the Memory: Learning to Generalize Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2204-03609.creator: Jin Kim, Jiyoung Lee, Jungin Park, Dongbo Min, Kwanghoon Sohn
arxiv-2204-03609.description: Abstract † † This research was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) grant funded by the Korea government (MSIP) (NRF2021R1A2C2006703), the Yonsei University Research Fund of 2021 (2021-22-0001), and the Mid-Career Researcher Program through the NRF of Korea (NRF-2021R1A2C2011624). The rise of deep neural networks has led to several breakthroughs for semantic segmentation.

arxiv-2207-14057.title: Gravitational waves and the Higgs mass
arxiv-2207-14057.creator: Rui Santos
arxiv-2207-14057.description: Abstract One of the simplest models that allows for an electroweak (EW) strong first order phase transition (SFOPT) while having a Higgs with the observed mass of 125 GeV is the singlet extension of the Standard Model (SM). We discuss two different phases of a complex singlet extension of the SM.

arxiv-2309-12621.title: The rational hull of modules
arxiv-2309-12621.creator: gangyong lee
arxiv-2309-12621.description: Abstract . In this paper, we provide several new characterizations of the maximal right ring of quotients of a ring by using the relatively dense property. As a ring is embedded in its maximal right ring of quotients, we show that the endomorphism ring of a module is embedded into that of the rational hull of the module.

arxiv-2401-12381.title: Computational Reverse Engineering Analysis of Scattering Experiments Method for Interpretation of 2D Small-Angle Scattering Profiles (CREASE-2D)
arxiv-2401-12381.creator: Sri Vishnuvardhan Reddy Akepati, Nitant Gupta, Arthi Jayaraman
arxiv-2401-12381.description: Abstract Characterization of structural diversity within soft materials is key for engineering new materials for various applications. Small-angle scattering (SAS) is a widely used characterization technique that provides structural information in soft materials at varying length scales (nm to microns).

arxiv-2407-03284.title: Aligning Planet-Hosting Binaries via Dissipative Precession in Circumstellar Disks NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , CMasher ( van der Velden 2020 )
arxiv-2407-03284.creator: Konstantin Gerbig, Malena Rice, J.J. Zanazzi, Sam Christian, Andrew Vanderburg
arxiv-2407-03284.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Konstantin Gerbig, Malena Rice, J.J. Zanazzi, Sam Christian, Andrew Vanderburg. Recent observations have demonstrated that some subset of even moderately wide-separation planet-hosting binaries are preferentially configured such that planetary and binary orbits appear to lie within the same plane. In this work, we explore dissipation during the protoplanetary disk phase, induced by disk warping as the system is forced into nodal recession by an inclined binary companion as a possible avenue of achieving orbit-orbit alignment.

arxiv-2602-05519.title: Wikipedia and Grokipedia: A Comparison of Human and Generative Encyclopedias
arxiv-2602-05519.creator: Ortal Hadad, Edoardo Loru, Jacopo Nudo, Anita Bonetti, Matteo Cinelli, Walter Quattrociocchi
arxiv-2602-05519.description: Abstract We present a comparative analysis of Wikipedia and Grokipedia to examine how generative mediation alters content selection, textual rewriting, narrative structure, and evaluative framing in encyclopedic content. We model page inclusion in Grokipedia as a function of Wikipedia page popularity, density of reference, and recent editorial activity.

britannica-1911-taylor-isaac-author.title: Taylor, Isaac (author) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-taylor-isaac-author.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-taylor-isaac-author.description: Article 'Taylor, Isaac (author)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Among his other works may be mentioned biographies of Ignatius Loyola (1849) and John Wesley (1851); a volume entitled The Restoration of Belief (1855); and a course of lectures on The Spirit of Hebrew Poetry (1861).

pmc-10694177.title: An anoikis-related lncRNA signature is a useful tool for predicting the prognosis of patients with lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-10694177.creator: Xin Jiang, Yu-lu Gao, Jia-yan Li, Ying-ying Tong, Zhao-yang Meng, Shi-gui Yang, Chang-tai Zhu
pmc-10694177.description: BackgroundAnoikis-related long non-coding RNAs (ARLs) play a critical role in tumor metastasis and progression, suggesting that they may serve as risk markers for cancer. This study aimed to investigate the prognostic value of ARLs in patients with lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD).

pmc-11333309.title: Psychotherapy focusing on dialogical and narrative perspectives: a systematic review from qualitative and mixed-methods studies
pmc-11333309.creator: Augusto Mellado, María Teresa del Río, Paola Andreucci-Annunziata, María Elisa Molina
pmc-11333309.description: IntroductionThis systematic review identified qualitative and mixed-methods empirical studies on psychotherapy from dialogical and narrative approaches, aiming to address the following questions: (1) How are subjectivity and intersubjectivity qualitatively understood in dialogical and/or narrative psychotherapies studied using dialogical and narrative approaches? (2) How do therapeutic changes occur, including their facilitators and barriers?

pmc-11532821.title: Magnetic resonance imaging studies on acupuncture therapy in cerebral ischemic stroke: A systematic review
pmc-11532821.creator: Mengyuan Li, Baohui Mu, Mengmeng Li, Xinyu Zhang, Jing Zhang, Haipeng Huang, Hongfeng Wang
pmc-11532821.description: Research has started using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) to elucidate the action of acupuncture on neuroplasticity following ischemic stroke (IS). Acupuncture is thought to be a potentially beneficial treatment for IS. However, the results remain inconsistent because of MRI processing techniques and study design variations.

pmc-12609627.title: The Chestnut and the Imperfect Crime: A Case Report of Femicide and Staged Road Accident
pmc-12609627.creator: Gennaro Baldino, Tindara Biondo, Cataldo Raffino, Marija Čaplinskienė, Stefano Vanin, Elvira Ventura Spagnolo, Jing Liu
pmc-12609627.description: Introduction: Charred bodies represents a significant challenge for forensic pathologists due to the destructive effects of fire on human remains. Although most fire-related deaths are accidental, cases of suicide and homicide are not uncommon. Case Report: We report a peculiar case of a severely burned body discovered inside a torched vehicle.

pmc-12630515.title: Prolyl endopeptidase is a multifunctional host factor required for FMDV infection
pmc-12630515.creator: Kun Ma, Rongzeng Hao, Tianran Liu, Yi Ru, Tao Feng, Xiaolan Qi, Yuzhe Wang, Bingzhou Lu, Sen Wu, Dan Li, Ran Zhang, Yaofeng Zhao, Haixue Zheng
pmc-12630515.description: Foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) poses a significant global threat to livestock production, underscoring the urgent need for a deeper understanding of virus-host interactions to develop effective prevention strategies. In this study, we identify prolyl endopeptidase (PREP) as a critical host factor in FMDV infection.

pmc-13214444.title: Construction of a reverse genetics and fluorescent reporter system for a bovine enterovirus isolated from cattle with diarrhea
pmc-13214444.creator: Qingting Dong, Yuhang Luo, Huanghao Liu, Zhuangzhu Zhou, Yeyong Li, Weijian Huang, Yan Pan
pmc-13214444.description: Bovine enteroviruses are widely detected in cattle, but molecular tools for functional studies and antiviral screening remain limited. In this study, a bovine enterovirus strain, GXHC2317, was isolated from diarrheic cattle in Hechi, Guangxi, China and propagated in BHK-21 cells.

pmc-13444289.title: Differential P3 reactivity to pornographic versus natural rewards as a neural marker of reward imbalance in problematic pornography use in young heterosexual men
pmc-13444289.creator: Yuanyuan Liu, Siying Zhong, Jianfeng Wang
pmc-13444289.description: Problematic pornography use (PPU) has been increasingly recognized as a behavioral addiction involving aberrant reward processing. However, few studies have examined reward imbalance—the co-occurrence of heightened reactivity to pornographic cues and reduced responsiveness to natural rewards—as a putative mechanism underlying PPU.
